title: Ari's reply blocks
description: A reply is Markdown. Where its content has a shape, Ari writes it as a fenced block whose info string is `ari:` and a kind, holding one JSON object, and the app draws it natively. A block the app doesn't recognise, or whose JSON doesn't parse, shows as its fenced text. Blocks are never spoken on a call.

Place.title: ari:place
Place.description: A place you might go. The app opens it in Maps.

Choices.title: ari:choices
Choices.description: Short answers you might give next, to tap. A tap sends the label as an ordinary message; unlike an ask, nothing waits for it.

Motion.title: ari:motion
Motion.description: A compact line under a reply when Ari starts or changes a thing in motion, such as "Florence trip: booked the Uffizi". Tapping it opens the thing. Draw the line from the `MotionChange` with that version, or from the thing's title when there's none.

change.description: The thing's version the line is about.

Images.title: ari:images
Images.description: Pictures Ari found on the web, kept on the server as attachments so the app never contacts their hosts. Never generated.

source_url.description: The page the picture came from.

credit.description: Who made it, as its source asks.
